description: Lists the reporting annotations of a GA4 property (notes on dates such as releases, tracking changes or campaigns, plus system-generated ones). Useful to explain jumps in data.

property_id.description: GA4 property ID, e.g. "123456789" or "properties/123456789" (not the G-XXXX measurement ID). get_account_summaries lists them.

name: list_property_annotations
title: Property annotations
